newsitem.title: USA: I.I.S. Intelligent names president, COO.
newsitem.headline: I.I.S. Intelligent names president, COO.

text.p: I.I.S. Intelligent Information Systems Ltd said on Friday it named Eli Shapira president and Itamar Eder chief operating officer.
Shapira will assume duties previously performed by Jacob Shemesh, chief sales executive, and Jacob Herbst, the company's chief executive.
Herbst will remain chief executive through the end of April and continue as chairman of the board. The company has not named Herbst's successor as chief executive.
Eder, the current chief financial officer, replaces Yeraeh Feigenbaum, who is leaving his post as of November 1, the company said.
Shapira has served as executive vice president for business development since April.
I.I.S., based in Yokneam, Israel, develops networking, data communication and peripheral products.
